items.title: Sampo Päällysaho Takes Over As CEO Of Tokmanni Group
items.summary: Sampo Päällysaho has taken over as the CEO of Nordic variety discount retailer Tokmanni Group and chair of its executive team.

items.title: Intesa Sanpaolo Backs Despar Nord With €30m Loan
items.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo has approved a €30 million loan to support the expansion and sustainability goals of Italian regional retailer Despar Nord.

items.title: Siplec E.Leclerc Teams Up With French Firms To Drive Low-Carbon Ethanol Production
items.summary: Siplec E.Leclerc partners with Vivescia and Roquette to develop a fully integrated, low-carbon ethanol value chain in France.

items.title: Penny Hungary Marks 30th Anniversary With New Logistics Investment
items.summary: As Penny Hungary celebrates its 30th year of operation, the discount retailer announced plans to expand its logistics centre in Alsónémedi.

items.title: BC Partners, CVC Set Sights On Italian Coffee Firm Segafredo Zanetti
items.summary: BC Partners and CVC are among buyout firms considering a potential bid for Italian coffee producer Segafredo Zanetti.

items.title: Greek Households Embrace Ready-To-Eat Food Items - IELKA Survey
items.summary: Ready-to-eat meals are gaining ground in Greek households, offering convenience without replacing traditional home cooking.
